title: Logistics Ease Across Different States LEADS Report 2022
definition: The LEADS (Logistics Ease Across Different States) Report 2022 is the 4th edition of an annual evaluation index released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, designed to assess the logistics performance, efficiency of supply chain infrastructure, and regulatory environment across all Indian states and Union Territories.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (government indices, socio-economic indicators, logistics policy) and Mains GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Infrastructure, Energy, Investment, Supply Chain, and Regional Development).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Logistics Ease Across Different States LEADS Report 2022.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic concepts of multimodal connectivity and logistics cost structures
